paper_title: NuSTAR bounds on radiatively decaying particles from M82
notes: Astrophysical bound from NuSTAR observations of M82 constraining axion-photon coupling for masses 30-500 keV. The exclusion region in Fig. 2 spans g_agamma ~ 1e-10 to 1e-12 GeV^-1. Exact numerical contour points not tabulated in the text; data_points are approximate bracket values inferred from the abstract/text (g12=0.75 benchmark at ma=316 keV implies ~7.5e-13 GeV^-1). Only rough endpoints could be extracted from text, so confidence is moderate.
